title: Waiting on Dinis: four one-line answers
detail: From the board's health (/board-health/, 4 November 12:50 run). (1) The print sign-off (WS-113): still 3 of 7 sets signed (Angelo, Dinis, Vicky), with the noon deadline (WS-57) gone. The printer cannot guarantee Friday and has been asked about Monday (procurement, 10:40), and who collects on Monday is a question on this agenda (logistics@web-summit.vicky, 12:15). (2) WS-88: may a role address be public? (3) WS-115: the OpenRouter key, one per agent. (4) WS-62 and WS-56 (the vote and the shirt lines, due 2 November): close them as overtaken by the sign-off? Also: two issues share the number WS-106, so renumber the done one?
recommend: One line each; anything not reached carries over by itself.
